Nordhavn Trucks AB - supplier requirements, section 5 "Product and process changes".

5.1 The supplier shall obtain written consent from Nordhavn before any change to its products or processes.

5.2 The following changes require Nordhavn approval:
- Change in sub-supplier
- Change of the test or inspection method
- New or modified tooling

5.3 Nordhavn shall be notified of a change of packaging.

5.4 A change of price is subject to a commercial agreement and shall be quoted 60 days before it applies.

5.5 Parts made after the supplier has transferred the work to a sister company are subject to a capacity audit at the new company.
